StarDraft 2

A StarCraft creation suite for map and mod creators. Built by the community, for the community.

StarDraft 2 aims to be the spiritual successor to StarDraft, the 1998 editor by Camelot Systems that powered the StarCraft modding community of the early 2000s.

Download for Windows Join the Discord

Changelog

All downloads: Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (AppImage)

Who it is for

Melee map makers

Paint terrain with brushes, spray, fill, replace and symmetry, or generate a full map. See the town area of each base, in HD, SD or Carbot graphics, and simulate melee mining and fights (experimental).

UMS & campaign makers

A modern classic trigger editor, unit, upgrade and technology settings, and mission briefings with preview. Campaign projects are coming soon.

EUD map makers

Edit unit, weapon, image and sprite data, and write triggers as blocks in plain sentences, or in your own epScript files. Checks find EUD errors and desyncs before you build, and the simulation (experimental) lets your custom units fight.

Mod makers

Integrated mod editing: make maps with your custom mod files, and manage them in one place. For mods for both StarCraft: Remastered and 1.16.1.

Coming soon

Roadmap

Sourced from user reports and feedback. Frequent releases are planned.

Now

Accelerated improvements, and the missing features based on early user feedback.

  • Clickable build errors

    Click a build error in the Log to open its trigger and block in the Triggers workspace.

    #R0036 · EUD

  • Terrain rendering accuracy

    All tilesets look the same in StarDraft 2 as in the game, in HD, SD and Carbot.

    #R0002 · Terrain

  • More EUD trigger blocks

    Blocks for common mapping tasks: center the screen, queue buildings, play animations, place sprites, and sprite effects.

    #R0050 · EUD

Next

Make StarDraft 2 a more powerful creation suite.

  • Batch trigger generation

    In Classic triggers, blocks of actions that repeat for each player, location or unit type ("For each unit in ..."), and that can nest.

    #R0023 · UMS

Later

Exploring how to enable the next evolution of StarCraft creations.

  • Signed program

    StarDraft 2 has a code-signing certificate, so that Windows and antivirus programs trust it.

    #R0056 · Platform

  • Replay preview

    Make a replay of the map with computer players, and watch it in StarCraft.

    #R0031 · Capability

  • Map import from scmscx.com

    Find a map on scmscx.com, and open it in StarDraft 2.

    #R0042 · Capability

  • More EUD blocks

    Blocks for drawing, queues and deques (with their methods and loops), and byte readers and writers.

    #R0063 · EUD

  • Custom keyboard shortcuts

    A menu where users change the keyboard shortcuts of StarDraft 2.

    #R0057 · UI

  • Remastered mod support

    Load a StarCraft: Remastered mod (MPQ or folder) on top of the game's files, and make maps with it.

    #R0026 · Mods

  • Simulation orders and timeline

    Give the simulated units orders by hand (move, stop, attack), and see the resources, the supply and the unit counts change over time, with a log of each event and its time.

    #R0064 · Capability

  • Map publishing

    Upload a map to scmscx.com from StarDraft 2.

    #R0045 · Capability

  • 1.16.1 mod support

    Load a StarCraft 1.16.1 mod, such as Cosmonarchy, and make maps with it.

    #R0046 · Mods

  • Version history

    Compare two versions of a map or project, and merge the changes.

    #R0047 · Capability

  • Map templates

    Start a map from a template, such as a defense map or an RPG, with its layout and triggers.

    #R0048 · UMS

  • Collaborative editing

    Two or more people edit the same map or project at the same time.

    #R0043 · Capability

  • Web build

    StarDraft 2 in the browser, with no installation.

    #R0030 · Platform
